column1: # Non-fatal qmllint warning ratchet for the CXX-Qt applications. A row may only
# fall, and it falls in the same commit that earns the reduction. New rows are
# added only when a new application is registered.
# The siderita row was re-measured under sorted order on 2026-10-08 (AUD-1-N):
# a correction of the measurement, not new debt.
# Every row was re-measured on 2026-10-09 under Qt 6.12.0's qmllint (CONV-1-A):
# the host upgraded from 6.11.1 and the new linter counts differently in every
# application, on main as well; a correction of the measurement, not new debt.
# The calcita row starts at 1, not 0 (EXT-1-A): Qt 6.12's qmllint reports the
# shared celestina-style/CelestinaIcons.qml as "not declared as singleton in
# qmldir" although every qmldir declares it, in every application that links
# it; Calcita's own QML lints clean.
# Every row rose by one on 2026-10-15 (CEL-1-C): Qt 6.12's qmllint reports the
# second shared singleton, celestina-style/CelestinaDesignTokens.qml, as "not
# declared as singleton in qmldir" in every application that links it,
# although every qmldir declares it; a correction of the measurement, not new
# debt. Hematita's +1 is assumed from the other seven, measured against their
# release modules; no Hematita release module was available, and the landing's
# own count confirms it.
